    assert len(paths) == 1, (name, paths)
    base_command += ['--extern', f'{name}={paths[0]}']
parent = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-c', f'safe.directory={root}', 'show',
    '02183e7c1:crates/deadlib-audio-backend-alsa/src/lib.rs'], cwd=root)
current = (root / 'crates/deadlib-audio-backend-alsa/src/lib.rs').read_bytes()
records = []
for name, data in [('parent', parent), ('current', current)]:
    path = folder / f'{name}.rs'
    path.write_text(data.decode() + '\npub fn alsa_layout_verify() -> u64 {\n'
        '    (std::mem::size_of::<AlsaParams>() as u64)\n'
        '        | ((std::mem::size_of::<AlsaOutputPrep>() as u64) << 16)\n'
        '        | ((std::mem::size_of::<AlsaHostClock>() as u64) << 32)\n}\n'
        '#[used]\nstatic ALSA_LAYOUT_VERIFY_ANCHOR: fn() -> u64 = alsa_layout_verify;\n')
    output = deps.parent / 'alsa-layout' / f'{name}.ll'
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    command = base_command + [str(path), '-o', str(output)]
    subprocess.run(command, check=True, cwd=root)
    ir = output.read_text()
    body = next(match.group(0) for match in re.finditer(r'^define[^\n]*\{\n.*?^}', ir,
        re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL) if 'alsa_layout_verify' in match.group(0).split('\n')[0])
    packed = int(re.search(r'ret i64 (\d+)', body).group(1))
    records.append(dict(stage=name, source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), command=command,
        params_bytes=packed & 65535, prep_bytes=(packed >> 16) & 65535, clock_bytes=(packed >> 32) & 65535,
        layout_function_ir=body))

    for path in sorted(original_deps.glob('*.rlib')):

        hashes[path.name] = hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

    for path in sorted(original_deps.glob(pattern)):
        if path.name not in hashes:
            destination = fixed / path.name
            shutil.copyfile(path, destination)
            hashes[path.name] = hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(fixed / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes, indent=2))
